chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Samāʿah, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about the khums, so he said: "It is upon everything that the people derive benefit from, whether little or much."

key_terms.الْخُمُسِ: khums; the one-fifth due on specified gains

ai.seo_question: Does khums apply only to certain gains, or to all profit whether little or much?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding khums, indicating that it applies to all forms of gain or benefit acquired by people, whether small or large. It is a foundational text in Shia jurisprudence for the broad scope of khums in financial matters.
